brief.question: How can a Proxyman-style desktop POC show live GraphQL and REST traffic with copy/share, repeat, Map Local (including a linked fixture file), Breakpoints and a Log Dashboard, so the person can learn how the pieces fit together?
brief.purpose: A learning POC for the person: inspect requests, copy a URL or cURL, repeat a call, answer an endpoint from Map Local, pause a real request at a breakpoint, and read one log dashboard for the session.
constraints: Clean room: never open, list, read, run or decompile the target
Build only inside app/; everything else is read-only
Rust + eframe/egui; build must succeed and --screenshot must produce a non-blank PNG
Never change host macOS proxy settings without explicit confirmation
brief.done_when: The app builds, draws a real window, captures or simulates GraphQL and REST calls, copies URL/cURL, repeats, serves Map Local from inline JSON or a linked file, pauses at request/response breakpoints, shows a log dashboard, passes its tests, and rebuild_check reports it would pass.

handoff: DONE: Proxzy now has an ACP Bridge concept screen under Automation & agents, reachable from the sidebar, the command palette, Agent Control's Hook an IDE card and Screen Play's harness card. The screen explains editor -> ACP -> agent -> MCP -> tools -> Proxzy, runs an 11-message simulated ACP v1 session (initialize, session/new, session/prompt, session/update, session/request_permission, stopReason), stops at a permission gate with Allow once / Always allow / Reject, and offers copy-ready Editor config, MCP entry and Agent prompt tabs. The tutorial is now a 13-stop tour with a dedicated ACP stop and drawing after the IDE hook; all counts are dynamic and tests cover the order. README documents the screen, triggers, layout files and the real-vs-simulated boundary. VERIFIED: cargo test 75 passed / 0 failed; cargo build clean with no warnings; screenshots app/shots/acp.png, acp-full.png, acp-deny.png, tour-acp.png, tutorial.png, screen.png, agent.png, agent-hook.png; latest rebuild_check says 'This would pass.' TRAPS: views.rs, rules_ui.rs, studio_ui.rs, tour_ui.rs, acp.rs and acp_ui.rs are include!d from app.rs, never add mod declarations; the built binary is target/debug/proxzy (app/target is stale); run screenshots from the repo root; never open /Applications/Proxyman.app or run networksetup without explicit confirmation. Demo triggers: PROXZY_VIEW=acp; PROXZY_DEMO=acp-replay|acp-full|acp-deny|tour-acp|agent-hook.
